sloka: तान्यक्षराणि सत्यानि यथावृत्तानि पूर्वशः ।श्रुत्वा पुरुषशार्दूलो विसञ्ज्ञो बाष्पलोचनः ।। ७.७१.१६ ॥
transliteration: tānyakṣarāṇi satyāni yathāvṛttāni pūrvaśaḥ ।śrutvā puruṣaśārdūlo visañjño bāṣpalocanaḥ ।। 7.71.16 ॥

translations.english: Having heard those true words, which recounted events exactly as they had formerly happened, Rama, the tiger among men, became bewildered with tearful eyes.
